India NSA Doval and Iran Security Chief Discuss West Asia Conflict

India's National Security Advisor Ajit Doval held a phone conversation with Iran's Security Chief Mohsen Rezaei. The discussion focused on the ongoing conflict in West Asia and bilateral issues between the two countries. The call took place amidst heightened tensions in the Gulf region.
